text:
priya_sec: Quick sync request — pen test scope + threat-modeling + retest timeline. We got the vendor intake this morning and need to align infra, SRE, and product before we ingest the full report. Who can do a 1h sync tomorrow?

ethan_sre: I can do 10–11am PT. Need to confirm which environments they'll scan (staging only vs. prod-read).

lina_pm: Staging only initially. Prod-read for a couple endpoints is allowed behind feature flags — will follow up with list.

alex_r: FYI vendor asked for a KMS / key-id to simulate encrypted payloads. We need to decide on scoped test keys, not prod keys.

priya_sec: Correct — no prod keys. Proposal: create a short-lived test CMK in a dedicated test KMS account with strict RBAC. I'll draft the policy.

jamie_ml: Also want to get an audit-log plan in writing. If vendor exercises data plane flows, we need structured audit events captured (who, what, key-id, ciphertext length, request path).

ethan_sre: Can we standardize the log fields? If so I can add a parser rule for the ELK/traces to tag pen-test events. Something like: {actor, action, resource, key_id, request_id}.

priya_sec: Yes. I'll add a minimal schema. Also we need to define evidence handoff format — screenshots + raw logs + annotated request IDs. Link to intake checklist: https://redwood.internal/security/pen-test-intake-checklist (private).

alex_r: For RBAC, recommend a scoped role 'pen-test/vendor' with only kms:Encrypt kms:Decrypt on the test-key and read-only to specific endpoints. Sample IAM snippet I used last time: 
```
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/TEST-KEY-ID"}]}
```

priya_sec: That looks good. Add a condition to restrict by aws:SourceIp to the vendor IP ranges for the scan window.

jamie_ml: Re: remediation tracking — I'd prefer a single JIRA board for pen-test findings (SEC-PE- prefix) and a required label 'retest-required' for anything blocking. That way we can generate a retest bundle easily.

ethan_sre: We need runbook steps for on-call to triage high findings outside business hours. Can Security own initial triage then hand to eng teams?

priya_sec: Yes, security does initial triage. We'll create an on-call triage doc with escalation matrix and expected SLAs (critical: 4h, high: 24h).

lina_pm: Timeline ask from vendor: final report + retest window within 2 weeks. We should push back to 3 weeks to give teams time. Any objections?

alex_r: 3 weeks is safer. If a finding is trivial we can fast-track a retest but default window 3 weeks.

priya_sec: Agreed. I'll propose: vendor report delivered Day 0, triage complete Day 2, remediation plan Day 5, retest window opens Day 10 and closes Day 21.

devsec-bot: New intake created: SEC-INTAKE-2026-043, assigned to priya_sec. Evidence folder: s3://redwood-pen-tests/SEC-INTAKE-2026-043/ (permissions=restricted)

jamie_ml: For retest validation, we should require: (1) PR with test that exercises fix or a replay harness, (2) logs showing request_id for original finding, (3) regression test added to nightly evals.

ethan_sre: On verification, SRE will run the vendor test against staging in our isolated network and confirm results. Need a checklist item to rotate test-key after retest.

priya_sec: I'll produce a 1-page runbook including: KMS test-key creation + deletion steps, RBAC policy template, audit-log schema, intake checklist, JIRA naming conventions, and retest acceptance criteria. Will share before tomorrow's sync.

lina_pm: I'm scheduling the 1h sync at 10:00am PT tomorrow and invited eng, infra, SRE, and vendor rep. Agenda: scope confirmation, KMS & RBAC plan, audit logging, intake evidence format, and retest timeline.

alex_r: Adding a quick note: any network egress for vendor tests must go via our jump-hosts; vendor IPs + egress rules will be in the runbook.

priya_sec: Perfect. Post-sync action: priya_sec to create SEC-EPIC JIRA and assign remediation owner per finding. We'll require status updates every 3 days until retest.

jamie_ml: One last ask — include an acceptance signer from product for any user-impacting fixes.

lina_pm: Added. See you tomorrow. :calendar: 

priya_sec: Thanks everyone. I'll drop the draft runbook & templates into the intake doc before the meeting. :thumbsup:
